_usage: SINGLE-PASTE. Self-contained — paste this whole file into Design Arena. It carries all the data and structure needed to generate the full site in one pass. Replace every <<CONFIRM>> with client-verified data before publishing anything public. Never fabricate medical claims, credentials, awards, stats, or reviews.
role: You are the lead Digital Transformation Consultant, Creative Director, Enterprise UX/Information Architect, Next.js architect, Medical SEO + AI-Search (SAG·EO) specialist, and personal-branding strategist for a premium Ayurveda healthcare website. Build a modern, classy, brand-colour-centric, fast, accessible website for Susrutha Ayurveda. It should feel like a trusted institution with heritage — the Mayo Clinic's credibility + a heritage-luxury brand's craft + Apple's restraint, expressed through authentic Kerala Ayurveda. No template feel, no filler, no emojis.

build_stack.frontend: Next.js (App Router, TypeScript, SSG for content, ISR/SSR where fresh data matters)
build_stack.styling: Tokenized system — CSS variables / Tailwind mapped to brand tokens. No hardcoded colours.
build_stack.backend_target: Content is CMS-driven (Django + MySQL). Doctor/treatment/condition/package/article/branch/testimonial/FAQ pages are dynamic templates, not hardcoded. Build them to consume a JSON/REST content model; where no live API exists, render from the seed data below.
build_stack.animation: Framer Motion / CSS + IntersectionObserver. Honour prefers-reduced-motion. Zero layout shift.
build_stack.3d: Lightweight (R3F/Three, or optimized SVG/Lottie/video where cheaper). Lazy-load, degrade gracefully, never block LCP.
build_stack.icons: One premium line-icon set (Phosphor or Lucide) + custom botanical/therapy SVG glyphs. No emojis.

brand_system.note: Exact Susrutha hexes are unconfirmed — extract from client logo and swap in. These premium Ayurveda defaults are safe to build with. Never use generic medical blue.
colour_rules: Deep green = authority/headers/trust anchors. Gold = accents & credentials only, never large fills. Cream/sand = calm reading surfaces. One confident CTA colour per viewport; never two loud colours competing.
Botanical texture + generous whitespace over gradients. No neon, no heavy shadows, no clipart.

typography.display: High-contrast elegant serif for headlines (Cormorant Garamond / Fraunces) — heritage + premium.
typography.body: Humanist sans for body/UI (DM Sans / Inter) — clarity + modernity.
typography.rule: Serif for emotion & authority, sans for information & interface. Support Malayalam script for local names/terms.

motion_and_3d.principle: Motion serves comprehension and calm, never spectacle. Organic easing, restrained duration, performance-safe, reduced-motion fallback for every effect.
signature_moments: Hero: layered 3D/parallax botanical or herb-and-brass-mortar scene with slow ambient drift; headline stays crisp and legible; must not block LCP.
Legacy timeline: scroll-driven reveal 1970 → today; milestone nodes animate in.
Panchakarma/therapy explainer: animated step-by-step process diagram.
Director sections: cinematic scroll with depth/parallax portrait, animated pull-quote, credential reveal.
Cards: premium hover (subtle lift, gentle image zoom, accent underline).
Counters: animate only verifiable numbers (beds, years, branches).

guardrails: Never fabricate medical claims, credentials, awards, statistics or reviews. Honour every <<CONFIRM>> — leave a content slot rather than invent.
YMYL discipline: educational framing, no diagnosis/cure promises, always route to consultation. Distinguish 'what Ayurveda traditionally addresses' from 'guaranteed results'.
Brand tokens only; premium icons only; no emojis; no template feel; no filler; no duplicate content.
Motion & 3D must never cost accessibility or Core Web Vitals.
Every page must earn its place on at least two of: user value, SEO/SAG·EO value, trust value, conversion value.
deliver: A production-ready Next.js site matching this structure and design language: reusable components, dynamic templates (doctor/treatment/condition/package/article/branch), working booking + enquiry + contact + FAQ + search, full schema/SEO/SAG·EO, Lighthouse 95+, WCAG 2.2 AA. Provide a short README (routes, brand tokens, how to add a doctor/treatment/package).
